name: gmail_search_first_result_subject
intent: Search Gmail and get the subject of the first result
description: Searches Gmail for a user-provided term, opens the first matching email, and returns its subject line from the opened conversation.
patterns: search my mail for something and tell me the first subject
find emails about a topic in Gmail
what is the subject of the first email matching a search
search Gmail for a sender or keyword

inputs.name: search_term
inputs.description: The term to search for in Gmail.

steps.intent: Tap the Search in mail field
Type {{search_term}} into the Search in mail field and submit the search
Tap the first result in the search results list

outputs.name: subject
outputs.example: envoy, take 40% off at these spots ..
